desc: Ideation: identify prefix-sum + binomial expansion as the O(NK) solution.
Parse N, K, A and maintain prefix sums P_j mod 998244353 incrementally.
Precompute binomial coefficients C(K,t) for t=0..K.
Maintain moments M[e] = sum over previous prefix indices i<j of P_i^e, initialized M[0]=1 (P_0=0), M[e]=0 for e>=1.
For each j, add sum_t C(K,t)*P_j^t*(-1)^(K-t)*M[K-t] to the answer using running powers of P_j.
After processing each j, update M[e] += P_j^e for all e.
Output the accumulated answer modulo 998244353 and validate against the three samples (75, 0, 428633385).
